items.title: Fibres of a surjective locally finite type morphism from an irreducible scheme to the spectrum of a valuation ring are equidimensional
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a morphism from an irreducible scheme to the spectrum of a valuation ring which is locally of finite type and surjective, the lemma shows that the special fibre is equidimensional with dimension equal to that of the generic fibre (statement lines 3652-3658). The proof begins with a reduction that is legitimate because replacing the source by its reduction changes neither the dimension of the scheme nor that of the special fibre, after which the source is integral and the statement becomes the corresponding algebra lemma about a finite type domain over a valuation ring (proof lines 3660-3664). The claim is H2: one reduction and one cited algebra input, with the reduction itself written out and the reason it is harmless stated explicitly.
